package.author: IDmelon Technologies Inc.
package.description: IDmelon Pairing Tool lets you use your smartphone for login to online account and Windows.

en-US.author: IDmelon Technologies Inc.
en-US.description: IDmelon Pairing Tool lets you use your smartphone for login to online account and Windows.
en-US.longDescription: IDmelon Pairing Tool is a piece of software to install on PC. It lets you pair your smartphone with PC to use it instead of entering a password to log in to accounts such as Microsoft or Twitter. A quick, affordable, convenient, and secure way to avoid account takeovers.
en-US.name: IDmelon Pairing Tool

zh-CN.longDescription: IDmelon Pairing Tool 是一款安装在电脑上的软件。它能让您的智能手机与电脑配对，从而替代密码登录微软或 Twitter 等账户。这是一种快速、经济、便捷且安全的方式，可有效防止账户被盗。
